integrity_statement: All-time identity is proved by incidence-flow representation and orthogonal edge-space decomposition. The large-branching expansion is analytic. Finite computations are supplementary, not substitutes for proof. Historical equivalence beyond inspected primary sources remains possible.
scientific_limitations: Finite unweighted two-generation regular trees with unit symmetric jump rates. The sharp coefficient 10 in the large-branching deficit is along equal branching only; the exact finite-time formula is a maximum of two edge-orbit expressions, not a globally asserted dominance theorem.
title: Exact transient Wasserstein amplification on two-level regular trees
